description: Returns the yield on a security that pays periodic interest.

params.description: The settlement date of the Treasury bill, expressed as a serial date number.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The maturity date of the Treasury bill, expressed as a serial date number.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The annual coupon rate of the security.
params.name: arg3

params.description: The purchase price of the security, per $100 par value.
params.name: arg4

params.description: The redemption value of the security, per $100 par value.
params.name: arg5

params.description: The number of interest payments per year. The possible values are: 1 for annual payments, 2 for semiannual payments, 4 for quarterly payments.
params.name: arg6

params.description: The day count basis to use: **0** or omitted - US (NASD) 30/360; **1** - Actual/actual; **2** - Actual/360; **3** - Actual/365; **4** - European 30/360.
params.name: arg7

signature: YIELD(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg4: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg5: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg6: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg7?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
